# OpenSSH key fixtures

Generated locally with OpenSSH `ssh-keygen` (no third-party data):

- `enc_ed25519` — ed25519 key, passphrase `correct horse`
- `enc_rsa` — RSA-2048 key, passphrase `Hunter2!`
- `plain_ed25519` — ed25519 key, no passphrase

They are disposable test keys; they protect nothing.
